name: freya
description: Tungsten's built-in coding agent. Local-first, BYOK, no telemetry.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The light lane (autocomplete, commit messages, explanations) runs on the embedded local model, only reads, and stays on. The agent writes files and can run commands, so it is paused until you trust the folder.

chatParticipants.name: freya
chatParticipants.description: Ask about the editor, its settings and keybinds -- or a small coding question

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Freya
walkthroughs.description: Freya has its own local model built in. Nothing to install.

steps.title: Everything light already runs locally
steps.description:
Autocomplete, commit messages and code explanations run on a 1.5B model that ships with the app. No installation, no sign-in, no network traffic.
[Explain selected code](command:freya.explainSelection)

steps.title: Instructions go to the second local model
steps.description:
Explaining code, rewriting a selection, fixing an error, generating tests and the chat all run on a 3B instruct model that ships with the app. It loads on first use and releases the memory when idle.
[Rewrite a selection](command:freya.inlineEdit)

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.description:
Freya is the default participant in the chat panel.
[Open the chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

enumDescriptions: The embedded 1.5B model that ships with the app. Requires no installation.
Your own Ollama. Use this if you would rather run a different small model.
freya.light.backend.description: COMPLETION lane: inline completion, next-edit prediction, the ghost-text syntax fix and commit messages. The instruct lane (explain, rewrite, fix, tests, chat) is always the embedded 3B.

freya.local.enabled.description: Use the embedded local model (llama.cpp + Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B) for the light tasks. Off = fall back to Ollama.

freya.local.port.description: Port for the embedded llama.cpp server. 11434 belongs to Ollama and is never used.

freya.local.contextSize.description: Context window for the embedded model.

freya.local.runtimePath.description: Custom path to the freya-runtime folder. Empty = look in the app's resources.

freya.runtime.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Where Freya downloads a model from when it is not bundled with your build. Defaults to Tungsten's own release bucket, which serves byte-for-byte the same weights that ship inside the bundled installer. Point this at your own mirror (an internal host, a file server, or `https://huggingface.co`) and nothing needs rebuilding. The path under this base and the SHA-256 are fixed in the extension; a download that does not match the expected size and checksum is deleted.

freya.instruct.enabled.description: Use the embedded 3B instruct model (llama.cpp + Granite-3B-Code-Instruct) for Explain, Inline edit, Fix, Generate tests, the refactor actions and the built-in guide chat. Off = those features say they are unavailable.

freya.instruct.port.description: Port for the embedded instruct llama.cpp server. 11434 belongs to Ollama and 11435 to the FIM model; neither is ever used.

freya.instruct.contextSize.description: Context window for the instruct model. Larger than the FIM model's because an instruct prompt carries a file plus a diff.

freya.instruct.runtimePath.description: Custom path to the freya-runtime folder for the instruct model. Empty = look in the app's resources.

freya.instruct.idleUnloadMs.description: Release the instruct model from memory after this many milliseconds of inactivity. 0 = keep it loaded. Minimum 30000. The point is that the 1.5B and the 3B are not forced to be resident at the same time on an 8 GB machine.

freya.secrets.enabled.description: Warn about secrets on paste and before commit. Runs entirely locally (pattern matching, no model).

freya.ollama.url.description: Address of Ollama. Only used when freya.light.backend is set to ollama; the default build needs nothing installed.

freya.autocomplete.enabled.description: Inline completion from a local FIM model.

freya.autocomplete.model.description: FIM model in Ollama. Must be a base model, not an instruct model.

freya.nextEdit.enabled.description: Predict WHERE the next change goes after you edit a line, and suggest what should be there. Runs on the local FIM model. Nothing is ever applied without you accepting it.

freya.tentative.enabled.description: Tentative completions in three narrow spots where the local FIM model has to guess a little intent: the body of a catch block, a regex literal you just opened, and the it()/expect() skeleton in a test file. They are guesses -- press Esc to dismiss. Turn this off to keep completion to what the model can read straight off the surrounding code.

freya.syntaxFix.enabled.description: When the parser reports a syntax error, guess the missing characters and show them as faint ghost text. Tab accepts. Runs on the local FIM model; semantic errors go to the instruct model instead, and only when you click the error.

freya.autocomplete.debounceMs.description: Delay after the last keystroke before a suggestion is fetched.

freya.autocomplete.prefixChars.description: Number of characters before the cursor sent as context.

freya.autocomplete.suffixChars.description: Number of characters after the cursor sent as context.
